work.heading: Work
work.intro: Seven projects. The first is my own product, with the ad numbers to go with it. The rest are CAT Reloaded events where I ran the media.

canva.title: Canva Course
canva.subtitle: My own product launch
canva.role: Course, content, and paid ads: all mine.
body: I built an online course, Earning from Design on Canva (⁨الربح من التصميم على كانفا⁩), and sold it myself, delivered through Google Drive.
To find students I ran a Meta Messaging campaign, so every ad opened a direct conversation.
I tested a video creative against an image creative. Both cost the same per conversation; the video started more of them.
canva.abHeading: A/B test: same cost, different pull

booth.title: CAT Booth
booth.subtitle: The season's launch event
booth.role: Led the media plan and coverage.
body: The first and most important event of every CAT Reloaded season: the booth that introduces the foundation to students across faculties, including Fine Arts, Commerce, Engineering, and Computers & Information.
I led the media plan and the coverage.

helloworld.title: Hello World X
helloworld.subtitle: Speaker and media lead
helloworld.role: Spoke on stage; led the event's media coverage.
body: CAT Reloaded's onboarding event for new students.
I gave a session on media from the stage, and led the media coverage of the event around it.

podcat.title: PodCAT
podcat.subtitle: A tech podcast series
body: A podcast hosting well-known Egyptian technology figures, including Osama Elzero, Ahmed El-Emam, and Mohamed Fathy.
I directed its media and production.

station.title: CAT Station V.7
station.subtitle: Training program launch
body: The launch campaign for CAT Reloaded's training program, across six technical tracks: Data Science, Back-End, Front-End, Flutter, UI/UX Design, and Cyber Security.

catathon.title: CATathon
catathon.subtitle: Capture The Flag competition
body: The promotion and registration campaign for a cybersecurity Capture The Flag challenge.

scoop.title: CAT Scoop
scoop.subtitle: Season finale
body: The season's closing event, covered as a set of eight designed posts.

about.heading: About
about.portraitAlt: Ahmed Atia in a black suit and tie, seated on a wooden bar stool against a grey wall.

roles.title: Head of Media
roles.summary: CAT Reloaded is a non-profit student foundation focused on Computer Science, IT, and open-source technology.
points: Led a media department of 100+ members across 6 circles: Photography & Videography, Video Editing, Graphic Design, Motion Graphics, Content Writing, and Marketing.
Ran the foundation's Facebook and Instagram pages: the content calendar, approvals, and posting-time strategy.
Supervised how new members were trained after recruitment, working with each circle head so skills were taught correctly.
Directed media for the full annual event cycle.

roles.title: Photographer & Videographer
roles.summary: Covered events as a member of the Photography & Videography circle: choosing angles, lighting, and shooting locations on site.

roles.title: Content Creator
roles.summary: Taught myself content creation, then built and sold my own online Canva course.
